messages:
leila: running onboarding sampleapp (js) with prefetch=3 + maxConcurrency=6 and seeing occasional duplicate pages + 429s. suspect interaction between auth-refresh retries and our paginator prefetch.

jon: can you paste logs or a tiny repro? is this reproducible in CI?

leila: here's a minimal snippet from local run:

```
DBG fetch page cursor=x1 -> items=20
DBG request got 401 -> triggering token refresh
DBG token refresh ok
DBG retry request cursor=x1 -> 429
DBG fetch page cursor=x2 -> items=20
DBG fetch page cursor=x1 -> items=20   // duplicate
```

marco: this screams "replayed request object". some HTTP libs re-send the exact body after auth refresh; if body contains cursor snapshot it will fetch stale cursor. python sdk added a "cursor_guard" last quarter to avoid this. js sdk hasn't.

leila: workaround: set prefetch to 1 or serialize inflight requests per cursor. both helped locally.

jon: long-term we should add a retry hook into the JS SDK: shouldReplay(oldReq, state) -> bool. default true, but paginator can use it to prevent replay when oldReq.body.cursor != state.latestCursor(streamId). also emit a metric when we drop a replay.

marco: agree. also add an e2e that simulates auth failure mid-prefetch so we catch regressions.

ci-bot: Created issue #3729: "js: paginator replay with auth refresh causes duplicate pages"

leila: I'll open a PR with small retryGuard + docs update for sampleapp recommending prefetch <= concurrency until fix lands. adding repro script to the issue.

jon: thanks. include a changelog note if disabling replay becomes default for paginators (minor bump).

leila: will do, ping me for review.
